comparison.objective: Separate a mixed batch using a manual screen vs pick four parts from two moving lanes before deadlines.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-sensitive particle passage and bridge clearing vs time-prioritized interception and direct pick-and-place from conveyors.
comparison.success_condition: Full feed, ≥98% media recovery, washers retained, no spill vs each cube placed directly in the bin before leaving reach, with no temporary staging.
comparison.reason: The record tests scheduling and dynamic picking; the candidate tests bulk separation physics.
